name: Elemental Witches
description:
About This Game

Core gameplay description:

  • Real-time switching of character/elemental skills

  • Survivor mode in a level-based setting

  • Skills composed of elements, and elements also serve as skills

  • Multiple styles

Real-time skill switching, creating your own combo

You can master over 20 different skills, all belonging to a certain element category. The effects of these skills vary - combining skills of different attributes can trigger a powerful elemental reaction.

Thrilling battles where you unleash your own unique magic combos：

You can activate the summoning skill to release the monster waves, then use the area-of-effect skills to deal tons of damage. The damage increase effect and the elemental chain reaction bring a strong sense of dopamine.

Get familiar with the game to unlock your own witch artifact:            

There are 24 unique witchcraft tools. Each of them has its own distinctive attack method and effect. 

Choose companion animals and unique pets for each elemental character：

Different animal companions provide unique gold-collecting behaviors and help ease the pressure on the battlefield, while each pet offers its own distinct combat experience.

Key Features：

  • Switch characters in real time.

    All characters share the same HP pool, but each has unique Defense and Movement Speed. Managing who on the field and when is essential to adapting to changing battle conditions.

  • Combine elements to unleash 21 different skills.

    Each elemental skill interacts differently, and various combinations create completely distinct combat styles.

  • Roguelite in-run growth with random items.

    Every run brings new builds, new item synergies, and a fresh gameplay experience.

  • Unlock pets through meta-progression.

    Each pet changes the flow of combat, offering unique strategic possibilities in every run.

  • Allocate resources among the three Elements.

    Different upgrade priorities create different growth paths and playstyles within each battle.

  • Regular developer updates.

    Continuous improvements and new content keep the game growing over time.

Brief Description:

In Elemental Witches world, you command the natural forces of Fire, Wind, and Thunder, combining them freely to unleash a wide variety of elemental spells.
Each spell is formed from three elemental orbs, and merging three identical elements summons a powerful Elemental Familiar to fight alongside you.
Your choice of element combinations, the abilities of your familiars, and the decisions you make during combat shape entirely different builds and battle experiences.

The game follows a Rogue / Roguelite core loop. After every battle, you can upgrade your elements, enhance your base attributes, unlock new items with unique mechanics, and gain meta-progression that persists between runs.
Different upgrade priorities lead to dramatically different strategies:

  • Specialize in a single element to unleash devastating spell power.

  • Develop its matching elemental familiar to create a reliable frontline companion.

  • Or balance multiple elements, adapting your build to shifting enemy waves and evolving battlefield challenges.
short_desc: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.
